scripts.build: npm run build -w @roaming/shared && npm run build -w @roaming/server && npm run build -w @roaming/client
scripts.dev: npm run build -w @roaming/shared && concurrently -n shared,server,client -c magenta,cyan,green "npm run dev -w @roaming/shared" "npm run dev -w @roaming/server" "npm run dev -w @roaming/client"
scripts.dev:client: npm run build -w @roaming/shared && npm run dev -w @roaming/client
scripts.dev:server: npm run build -w @roaming/shared && npm run dev -w @roaming/server
scripts.test: npm run build -w @roaming/shared && npm run test -w @roaming/shared && npm run test -w @roaming/server && npm run test -w @roaming/client
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @roaming/shared && npm run typecheck -w @roaming/shared && npm run typecheck -w @roaming/server && npm run typecheck -w @roaming/client
